answer_1.quote: The objective of automatic text summarization is to condense the content of an original document while preserving its essential information.
answer_1.outputs: Extractive summaries composed of selected sentences from source documents.

answer_2.quote: we follow previous work in text summarization and related tasks to mainly report ROUGE-1 (unigram), ROUGE-2 (bigram), and ROUGE-L (longest common subsequence) scores for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We performed a human evaluation based on our model's outputs and those released by MATCHSUM. We randomly sampled 50 test instances from CNN/DM and focused on two critical aspects: relevance (whether the output summary is relevant to the source document) and faithfulness (indicating the degree to which the output summary faithfully represents the source document). Three proficient English-speaking students scored them on a scale ranging from 0 (poor) to 2 (excellent), and averages were computed for each aspect.
answer_4.guideline: Scored on a scale of 0 to 2 for relevance and faithfulness.
